searchText: We recently launched Stoffel https://x.com/StoffelMPC/status/2069457347592794576 Here's the Github repo: https://github.com/Stoffel-Labs/stoffel If anyone here is looking for private computation, check it out We are working on a Solidity SDK as well (wasn't ready before cutting 0.1.0 so we have more time to refine it) Do you have a doc on the cryptography design somewhere? So far I've seen the phrase "secure multiparty computation" many times in the docs but nothing about how that's actually realized. It's in the MPC Backend section docs.stoffelmpc.com So many Claude-isms in these docs Yeah, I'm passing through them because it's a mishmash of different models when we were still building <@1285003440220803092> I've pushed an update Didn't get rid of the Claude-isms and didn't update the introduction section but the rest of the docs are better than they were last weekk
